issues.description: Constructor parameter order for class Meal differs between artifacts. The problem statement UML declares Meal(String, String[]) (name then ingredients). The solution implements public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients). The template implements public Meal(String[] ingredients, String name) (ingredients then name), while the example usage in Main uses new Meal("cowBoyStew", new String[]{...}) (name first). This mismatch will cause compilation errors or confusion when students follow the UML/solution or the example code.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Meal constructor in the template to public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients) so the parameter order matches the UML, the solution, and the example usage. Update the constructor body to assign this.name = name; this.ingredients = ingredients; and adjust any code that relied on the reversed order (or, alternatively, update example calls to match the chosen signature — prefer making the template match the UML/solution).
